notes.title: 1.0 update preview and upcoming price change
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]1.0 release is just around the corner, and we wanted to share a small preview of what it will look like.[/p][p][/p][h3]Roads[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/release_description_gifs/sp_roads.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]They serve as an organizing tool and also look cool.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bosses[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/release_description_gifs/sp_bosses.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each is unique in its own way. Destroying an enemy tower will spawn one of the bosses the following night, so be sure you’re ready to meet them![/p][p][/p][h3]Achievements[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38552934/f2435b6b7495566fafd3b8ade110c39c9675bb9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yes, finally achievements are coming to Steam! Are you ready?[/p][p][/p][h3]Steam deck and full controller support[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38552934/8d4096a43f83fe20a18c6025815fdcb5c62263dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Completely new UI for a better keyboard/mouse and controller experience![/p][p][/p][h3]New guided tutorial[/h3][p]We’ve added a completely new guided tutorial that will help new players learn how to play the game. It might not be super exciting for you if you’ve played Becastled before, but it will help your friend who was waiting for a polished Becastled experience a lot.[/p][p][/p][h3]Optimizations and bug fixes[/h3][p]Performance and stability are much better now! Since we managed to make Becastled work on Nintendo Switch (add to your wishlists here: [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/becastled-switch/"]Becastled on Switch[/url]), the PC version also got a performance boost too.[/p][p][/p][h3]Missing 1.0 content[/h3][p]There will be a few things that will not be present in 1.0 from the Early Access description on our steam page. And we would like to adress those things.[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to add magic spells or mages into the game, but it contradicted our design idea of castle defense. If you imagine how castle defense looks, you might picture something like [i]Lord of the Rings[/i] moments - walls filled with archers and knights at the gate. If mages were more powerful, why would we need an army? We wanted army management to be a core part of the gameplay and didn’t want to create any workarounds in that regard and we didn't want to give too much power in the hands of a single unit.[/p][p][/p][p]The same thing happened to the idea of having heroes, like in Warcraft 3 let’s say. We end up creating elite unit level tier, just cool looking and slightly better stats then regular ones. This feature is already in the game.
[/p][p]We also discussed an idea of having a story campaign, but we couldn’t find a way to make it interesting without it just being a “do the same thing” type of campaign repeated 20 times. We might rethink it after the 1.0 release and expand our tutorial into a story campaign, but we’re not 100% sure about that yet.[/p][p][/p][h3]Price change[/h3][p]As we are exiting Early Access, we will be changing the base price of Becastled from $15 to $20, with regional prices applied. The new price will go live starting September 12.[/p][p][/p][p]We will also share some exciting news about post-1.0 soon![/p][p][/p][p]Let us know in the comments what you think about the 1.0 update and what you would like to see happen to Becastled post-1.0.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Becastled 1.0 launches October 23!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, we have some great news for you today!
[/p][p]After four years in Early Access, [b]Becastled 1.0 will launch in full on October 23[/b], arriving on PC, Steam Deck and consoles (PlayStation, Xbox, Switch) all on the same day![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this announcement, we have a shiny new artwork, a new trailer, and a fresh demo, available right now as part of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38747278/sale/ukrainiangamesfestival2025"]Ukrainian Games Festival 2025[/url] (which you should absolutely check out).[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/watch?v=lxI2MQzKIJw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This launch is possible thanks to our new publishing partnership with [u][url="https://pinglestudio.com/"]Pingle Studio[/url][/u], who are helping us give Becastled a final layer of polish and make a simultaneous PC + console release a reality.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve been with us since the start, THANK YOU. Your feedback since Early Access began in 2021 has shaped Becastled in countless ways. Over the next few weeks, we’ll share more about our final Early Access updates and what you can expect in 1.0.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330460/Becastled/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]And if this is your first time hearing about Becastled, please, check out the new demo, join our Discord, and tell us what you think. Even as we’re gearing up to leave Early Access, your feedback means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t believe this castle we’ve been building together is almost complete. Thank you for sticking with us & see you on the walls of the Sun Kingdom this October![/p][p][/p][p][b]— Mana Potion Studio[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Combat update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, our biggest update to date is live!

It's a complete overhaul of combat system with new features and better performance. Thanks to everyone who participated in beta, it helped us to fix a lot of bugs and adjust how new mechanis work.

What's new:
[list]
[*]Improved combat with deeper combat mechanics
[*]Enemy towers: destroy them all to win a map. But be prepared - you’ll be attacked with greater force!
[*]Map editor, create and share your own maps
[*]Mini-bosses can spawn every 5th wave, make sure you are ready to meet them! Each is dangerous in it's own way
[*]New river map scenario
[*]You can call militia at night to help you fight
[*]New units leveling system
[*]Pikeman have really long spears now
[*]Swordsman have shields from the start and can cover from arrows
[*]Enemy paths, you can see how enemies will move across the map
[*]Hundreds of new sounds
[*]You can give banners with auras to your units or place banners on walls or towers
[*]Water will freez in winter creating new paths for enemies
[*]Sandbox mode
[*]Combat difficulty now adjusts to your wealth and army size, fights can be more challanging on higher difficulties
[*]Improved game performance
[/list]

Let us know what do you think about new update in the comments!

notes.title: Combat update release date announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we have some great news for you today: the Combat Update will be released on [b]March 24[/b]! If you’d like to play it a bit earlier, you can join our public beta starting on [b]March 13[/b]. See the end of this post for details on how to join.

Check out our updated game trailer, which showcases our new vision for the game:

[previewyoutube=71i5Omi6caI;full]<youtube link>[/previewyoutube]

Our goal was to focus on improving the combat aspect of the game. Everything has been built from scratch to deliver a deeper and more engaging combat simulation experience. Performance has also improved significantly.

You will be able to create and share your own maps with the upcoming update. Modify the terrain and place resources as you see fit. Share your map with the community or download maps created by others.

And there is also sandbox mode, build and fight without any restrictions.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_release_date/map_editor.jpeg[/img]

We've added mini bosses with this update, they are bigger versions of regular units but they are much tougher. Killing one of them will give your units a lot of expirience.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_release_date/mini_bosses.jpg[/img]

If all of your troops fall in battle, you can summon a militia. Every villager will pick up a weapon and join the fight. However, be careful—this is your last line of defense.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_release_date/militia.jpg[/img]

To help you prepare for night battles, we’ve added a feature that shows enemy attack paths. This will be extremely useful when building walls and gates, allowing you to guide enemies into a deadly trap!

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_release_date/flow_field.jpg[/img]

There are many other changes as well, and we’ll post a full list on the release date!

How to join the open beta:
[olist]
[*] Right-click on Becastled in your Steam library.
[*] Select Properties -> Betas.
[*] Under Beta Participation, choose beta.
[*] That’s it! You’ll just need to wait until March 13.
[/olist]

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_release_date/beta.jpg[/img]

That's it for today, see you soon!

notes.title: Devlog: progress on the combat update #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's been a while, and we have some news on the progress of the upcoming combat update.

[h3]Map win condition[/h3]

Now you can win a map! There are 4 enemy towers on each side of the map, if you destroy all of them and survive the final enemy wave you win. You will still be able to play after that if you want to, but if you’re looking for a challenge, now you have it. Make sure you are ready to defend your castle, as a destroyed tower will summon a much bigger wave of enemies at night. And if you will destroy all towers you will have to defend against the final and strongest enemy wave.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/game_end.jpg[/img]

[h3]Better unit roles[/h3]

Since the release, we've struggled to find a good balance between our units, but I think we've found a good solution.

Swordsmen will now have shields by default, and they can use them to protect themselves from arrows. Along with better armor, this allows them to take significant damage and still survive

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/shields.gif[/img]

Knights still wield a big two-handed sword that deals splash damage, making them the most dangerous unit in melee combat.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/knights.gif[/img]

Pikemen now have long spears, which allow them to have greater attack range. By combining pikemen with knights or swordsmen, you can create a squad that fits your needs in terms of damage or defense

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/pikeman.gif[/img]

Archers are mostly unchanged, but they have almost no armor. So, leaving them alone in an open field at night might not be the best idea, as enemies also have units with shields.

[h3]New levels[/h3]

Levels make units more powerful than before, and you can easily see the unit level icon. Control and position your troops in a way that allows them to gain experience in each fight, and try not to lose too many of them.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/archers.gif[/img]

[h3]Dead or injured[/h3]

Speaking of that, you will be able to see how many of your troops died during the fight. A skull icon represents a unit that died, and a cross represents a unit that can be healed in a hospital. The more skulls, the bloodier the fight was. You can hire more doctors to increase the chance that a unit will not die in a fight.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/skulls.gif[/img]

[h3]Banners[/h3]

Also we've added banners that you could give to any unit, each banner will have different aura that will affect your troops. So now you will have much more tools to create unique defence strategies.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/banner3.gif[/img]

[h3]Smarter enemies[/h3]

You’ll need to be more creative defending your castle, as there will be more enemies, and they will be smarter this time! Enemies will bring siege ladders and towers only when it makes sense, saving time to reach the castle keep. They will also use rams to break through gate doors now.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/ram.gif[/img]

You will be able to see the possible enemy paths, which will help a lot when planning your defenses. The visuals are still a work in progress, but you can already see how enemy attack paths change when you place a wall. Enemies will choose to run around if it’s much faster than breaking down the wall, but if the detour is too far, they will try to break through the wall and might even use a siege ram to help them.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/flow.gif[/img]

[h3]New map[/h3]

All these new combat mechanics need a better world to truly shine. That’s why we’re working on new map types, along with a map editor, so you’ll be able to create custom maps with interesting designs and challenges. If you’d like, you can also share them with others through the Steam Workshop later on.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update_2/river_map.jpg[/img]

[h3]When it's going to be released?[/h3]

We wanted to release it much earlier, but as usual, things grew out of scope. We want to ensure this release is the most polished yet and that we deliver the best possible experience with it. We still aim to release it in a few months.

Let us know what do you thinkg about the upcoming update in the comments!

notes.title: Devlog: progress on the combat update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We want to share some progress we have made on the combat update.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/charge.gif[/img]

As we upgraded our AI, we discovered a cool way to make combat more dynamic. You can see in this clip how knights push archers while they fight. This creates more dynamic and interesting battles. You can feel that the knights overwhelm the archers so much that they push them back.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/troll2.gif[/img]

Check out how the troll pushes knights when moving. Cool, right?

This new technique will allow us to create enemies that cannot be stopped by regular troops. It's not just cool visuals, but also a way to create new combat challenges. Knowing that a troll will go through your troops no matter what forces you to come up with new strategies to handle this.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/walls.gif[/img]

This technique also allows units to move much faster on walls and ladders.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/formation.gif[/img]

These movement details bring more life to our simple characters, making them more realistic and alive.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/gate.gif[/img]

We are focusing on significantly improving siege gameplay. Fights at gates, on walls, and with siege towers and ladders have been completely reimagined and improved. With these changes, we aim to create the best strategy siege simulation game out there.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/progress_on_combat_update/catapult.gif[/img]

We are also working on new units and combat content, along with rebalancing old mechanics. We will be ready to share more details next time. Our goal is to make combat more challenging and to bring more depth to this part of the game.

See you next time!

notes.title: Devblog: working on a combat update & more
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We want to share with you our progress on the update we are currently working on. Our goal is to bring more depth to combat and siege gameplay. Making it more fun and challenging to defend your city. 

Also we are fixing issues related to AI and pathfinding that plagued game experience for many of you. We’ve completely rewritten AI for all units in the game. And it works way faster right now. Though we are not ready to share details on combat changes yet.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_180424/spawnunitssuperfast-optimize.gif[/img]

We are also working on an upgrade for the game map. The idea is to add more stuff to map generator, so that it will create more unique and interesting defense challenges. And we also want to include a map editor in the game, so that you could create and share custom maps.

Mountains, rivers, water cells and some other stuff. I think we will release these elements gradually with the next updates. For now I can share some concepts and early screenshots on how it looks

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_180424/photo-collage.jpeg[/img]

And our plan is also to release roads with one of the updates to the map editor.

[img]https://manapotionstudios.com/images/Becastled/combat_update_180424/road.jpg[/img]

That’s all for today, see you next time when we share more details on combat changes.

notes.title: New update: Seasons
notes.content:
Hello everyone, check out our new update: Seasons!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NqZoMEG.jpg[/img]

Now each day of the game will progress yearly seasons. Each season has a set of possible weather events and visual effects. For example, heavy rain could start in summer and lightning might hit one of your buildings!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PPNCDCG.jpg[/img]

Or you could see aurora in the winter if you get lucky.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NBszbz8.jpg[/img]

You should also prepare to survive a winter. Gather some stocks of food and wood as plants don't grow in winter.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TYsq2B.jpg[/img]

In general new changes make the game world more intractable while creating a challenge in surviving winter.

We also fixed wall gap bug. When enemies were able to squeze between wall/tower and a cliff. Now we are filling these spaces with stones that blocks the path. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KzKTETc.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] added:	Seasons! You can select winter duration in game settings
[*] added:	new resource: coal. Coal is now used to heat houses in winter
[*] added:	new building: Charcoal kiln
[*] added: weather events: rain, thunder storm, hail, blizzard, aurora, strong wind
[*] added:	map decoration: flowers

[*] added:	map decoration: butterflies during spring

notes.title: New update: Mood mechanic
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new update is live! This time we update how mood mechanics works. So no more tavern spam, but we hope you will like this change.

Buildings like tavern increase the mood of houses around them

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eYtK92f.jpg[/img]


A sawmill or stone query will decrease the mood of houses around it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1OzQUFd.jpg[/img]


So place your buildings carefully now! Positive mood counts toward golden age score, and when progress is full you get Golden Age for a short time. It increases production of all resources. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q9LmgQv.jpg[/img]


If your mood gets too low production of all resources is decreased and some workers may even leave your town!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bpQsCnI.jpg[/img]


In addition, you can get mood bonuses from nature features on cells, like lakes and forests.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tVdrOxS.jpg[/img]


We also added female characters, they can do work in the city or be in the army.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7eB7T8T.png[/img]

Other changes:

[list]
[*] added:	added traps menu
[*] added:	tower siege machine on/off switcher
[*] fixed: enemies not spawning sometimes
[*] fixed: being able to upgrade / destroy buildings in main menu using hotkey modes
[/list]

Also a lot of small issues was fixed.

Let us know what you think about the new mood mechanic in the comments!

notes.title: Devlog: Hospitals, tents, herbalists and more
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we are working on the new content update and we wanted to share some details about it.

[b]New revival mechanic[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p2XF3jf.png[/img]

Hospitals, tents and herbalists! We decided to change how revivalworks in the game. Now units fallen in combat become wounded and they can be healed in a hospital. Wounded units now take slots - hospital beds. Hospitals have some, and you will be able to place field tents to increase slots for wounded units. Also you can hire a herbalist so that he can gather some herbs, increasing the healing chance of wounded units.

[b]Barracks[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a3SSGj4.png[/img]

The army will now have a limit to how many units you can have. But you will be able to increase it by building more barracks. This way you will have to build some basic infrastructure to have a big army.

[b]Training camp[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ye2IAwi.png[/img]

Training camp is an advanced building in the military tab that will be able to train random units up to level 5. 

[b]Bakery and wheat production chain[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bDRkTUo.png[/img]

Wheat field now generates some amount of wheat that can be used directly by the bakery to create food. Or wheat can be processed to flour in a windmill to generate even more food in the bakery. 

[b]New hunter and wild animals[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xHy273q.png[/img]

Hunters will now hunt animals across the map, and animals will wander a bit. We wanted to make hunting more dynamic while still being easy to use. Allowing some animals to enter or leave the map later during Seasons update.

[b]Tech tree changes[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F5Swusa.png[/img]

We decided to use wood/stone/iron/gold as prices in the tech tree. Knowledge as a resource was very uninteractive and boring to play with. Now the research cost is spread between different resources and you will have to balance your research needs with other aspects of your economy.. We also added some new unlocks for the new buildings and to balance some old stuff.

We also added a lot of smaller changes and fixes that you will be able to check out pretty soon!

Hello everyone, check our new update that features our new mechanic: Traps!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOTJkMWRkYjczZWFkZTc0NWM2Mjg5ZmQ1MTAxNjgwNTQ0NTJiNDFlYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/3QGZPRMD9lSBqEjSmg/giphy.gif[/img]

Traps can help you defend your city. They trigger automatically when enemies are nearby. Right now there are two traps that you can use: Explosive Barrel and Arrow Wall Trap. What other traps should we add to the game? Let us know of your ideas!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rFYt4YnmC9shTtQkbi/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/089jCQY.jpg[/img]

Check out the new economy overview window. It shows you how much gold you generate from each source and how much you spend. It will help you to optimize your army and city.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lL1mSE1.jpg[/img]

Tower doors now connect to walls on different levels. You can also enable and disable each door, making the path possible or closed when designing your wall defenses.

notes.title: New Updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while since we posted any updates and we have some news for you! So what’s going on with Becastled? How is the dev team doing? Is the game abandoned? And is a new update coming on December 22?

First off, we did not stop working on Becastled. We made a lot of progress in the last year and a few months and you will see new updates and content very soon! We are committed to go through Early Access and to add a lot of features that we announced on launch day and also suggestions that we heard from you.

Why did we have such a huge gap in releasing new updates? Mostly because of our lack of experience on working on projects of this scale. We learned it the hard way, but we learned our lesson. We are going to make new updates faster now as we’ve adjusted our work pipeline to this approach.

And yes, a new tech update is releasing on December 22. And a new content update will be released on January 23!

Tech update is mostly a technical update that improves performance and behavior of our game and makes further development possible from the tech side of things. We still have a lot of content almost ready to go, as we shared before our roads system, seasons, new UI, fire system and much more. We will release them next year.

New tech update is already up on the beta branch, we are still testing it and fixing bugs but if you want to try it right now feel free to switch your game branch to beta. To do so right click on Becatled in your library list, then properties ➜ betas and select beta branch.

Dev team is relatively safe, we adjusted as much as we can to work and live during the war time in Ukraine.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Our life during last few weeks in Ukraine
notes.content:
Hello everyone. All our team members are from Ukraine and last weeks were life changing and heartbreaking for all of us. As you probably know, Russia started a full scale war against Ukraine. Every Ukrainian is affected and their lives are far from safe, and from what can be named normal.

We lived in Kharkiv and Kyiv that got heavily bombarded and are one of the hottest spots of this war. All team members are relocated to safer places now.

Obviously safety of our lives is the number 1 priority so we did not have any time to work on a game during these weeks and have left behind some devices which were important for work. It is really hard to return to the previous work schedule. But we are trying to restore our work on Becastled as much as possible. This will affect our update schedule. After the technical navigation update we will probably divide the City Building update into smaller parts to get things rolling.

Also we are stopping sales of all our games in the Russia and Belarus region. We can't entertain people that are responsible for the war against our country. Remember that the only thing necessary for the triumph of evil is that good men do nothing. 

Hopefully things get better and we will be able to return to peaceful times soon.

See you in the next devlog.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it’s devlog time!

It has been 7 months since the last update was released and we wanted to give you a more detailed view of what we have been doing and our development plans. So here are main answers in format of QA

Q: What is the current state of the game? Why has the latest update taken so long to develop?
A: We are currently working on two major tasks: content for the City Building update and the new unit navigation system. Nav system is a very heavy technical change to the game and is really important to get right, so we have prioritized it over content to get a smoother gaming experience in the end.

A lot of players had issues with low fps and lags after some time spent in a game. It is mostly due to the current navigation system. We are developing our own right now that will solve this issue, but it’s not an easy task and it is taking us a lot of time to create it and introduce into the game, but it is worth it as it’s custom built for the game and will have much improved performance and unit navigation. 

Q: Are you planning to develop the next updates in a similar time-span?
A: Definitely not! In the future we plan to release updates more frequently. Closer to 
 every 3 to 4 months.

Q: When will the City Building update be released?
A: The new navigation system will be released before the City Building update so we can test it properly, as it’s a very heavy modification to the technical aspects of the game. We are working on updating it as fast as we can. And then our focus will change to prioritizing content for the City Building update. We will announce release dates later.

Q: So how many updates are planned for this year?
A: Definitely more than last year!

Q: What about those cool community ideas that were shared on steam forums and on discord?
A: We sorted them into our to-do list. Most of them were already there, so we are working on making them happen one day.

Q: And what about bugs and other issues, will they be addressed?
A: Yes! We have a list of them too, and will gradually fix them.


We hope this answers most questions regarding the development state of Becastled. If you have more questions feel free to ask in the comments.


Also we wanted to share some models of destroyed buildings, it will be easier to restore your city if part of it got destroyed. Can you guess what buildings here were destroyed?

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’ve been pretty busy for the last few months working on the City Building update and here is a small recap of what we are doing.

[list]
[*] Weather system
[*] Seasons
[*] Roads
[*] Female characters
[*] More buildings
[*] New navigation system
[*] Roadmap 2021 update
[/list]

[h3]Weather system[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7rw5Q2imCxtWldER9x/giphy.gif[/img]
Lightning can start a fire or hit something made of metal


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TneNh7XAaVtUyHDZI8/giphy.gif[/img]
We are working on a fire system where flame is able to spread through grass, trees and buildings across the map. It might be an additional challenge for you, but no worries, as we will also add tools to fight it - such as fire brigade and regular villagers. With the right strategy you can use fire for your advantage in battles. Be careful though, as enemies can fire projectiles that can set your buildings or wood walls on fire!

[h3]Seasons[/h3]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/y1KB8cuL9TbtMxaIAo/giphy.gif[/img]
Seasons will add a long planning strategy to the game cycle. There is less food production in winter so you should stock some food in advance. Also make sure you have coal to keep your villagers’ homes warm! 

[h3]Roads[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BSRSzh0.jpg[/img]
[i]Roads concept, temporary design[/i]

We are also working on the road system. It will have an impact on buildings, and have a decorative function as well. We are almost finished with road placement mechanics and soon will start to work on its visuals. We will probably share some road gifs in the next blog post.

[h3]Female characters[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lQgrlV7.png[/img]
Villagers will have a random chance to be male or female, making your city more realistic

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IK7vDwI.png[/img]
You will be able to hire female warriors too!

[h3]More buildings[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jgbj9V4.png[/img]
Making charcoal will help keep houses warm and cozy during winter

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4O2912y.jpg[/img]
Zeppelin for air trading routes

[h3]New navigation system[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/h7kk799.png[/img]
A lot of you have issues with performance in long sessions, and one of the main reasons for that is navigation that we are currently using. So we are rewriting it from scratch for better performance and more possibilities. It will be possible to have bigger maps and bigger battles, but most importantly good FPS to enjoy the game at any stage. Results are pretty good so far, but it still needs more work. We’re also working on fixing navigation behaviour issues.

[h3]ROADMAP 2021 update[/h3]
Our 2021 roadmap is a bit outdated at this moment, as things take more time than we expected. We are still working on the City Building update and it needs more time to get finished. Unfortunately we can not release it this year. And next year after this major update we will work on “Sandbox” and “Magic and Bosses”. When the original 2021 road map is finished we will work on some other big ideas we have for the game before the final release. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Tech Tree Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Tech Tree update is live! It is the first content update for Becastled. We added some new features, let us know what you think about it in the comments. Detailed list of new content you can find below.

Also we are starting a screenshot contest! Share with us your best screenshots and some of them might end up on loading screens. More details on our discord server: https://discord.gg/RmBP3ba2yV

Also if you would like to help us translate Becastled to your language we will greatly appreciate that. More details on how to do this: https://discord.gg/fvu2nHkt3Y

Major features:
[list]
[*]Research Tree
[list]
[*]Now you can spend knowledge and different resources to unlock new technology or buildings
[*]With over 25 researches it provides a comprehensive upgrade path for your town
[*]The tree is split into 3 tiers, each new tier unlocks a new castle level that provides new bonuses and allows you to build higher tier building upgrades!
[/list]
[*]New Resources
[list]
[*]Iron - used for some buildings and for unit upgrades, you will find ore deposits on newly generated maps
[*]Knowledge - produced in the new Library building, can be spent on unlocking new researches
[*]Horses - required by Trading Post
[/list]
[*]Smithy and Unit upgrades - use the new Iron resource to upgrade units and siege machines equipment
[*]Resource trading - once you build a trading post you can exchange different resources for sunstone!
[/list]

New Buildings
[list]
[*]New Castle levels - unlock required research for each tier to upgrade your castle
[*]Library - new building that produces knowledge
[*]Observatory - gives bonus to library production, similar to the windmill
[*]Iron Furnace - place it on Iron deposit cells to extract iron
[*]Trading Post
[list]
[*]Buy and send caravans for additional income
[*]Unlocks the ability to trade your resources
[/list]
[*]Smithy - allows you to upgrade your soldiers and siege engines
[*]Butcher’s shop - gives bonus to meat food production in cell
[*]Vegetable field - new food producing building, unlocked via a high tier research, can be placed on any non-food resource tile
[/list]

New soundtrack! 
[list]
[*]2 day tracks and 2 night tracks
[/list]

Other changes and mechanics
[list]
[*]New Save system, now saves are organized by game worlds
[*]Workers will now go to their homes at night instead of teleporting, so make sure to provide them with a close enough home so they don’t get caught by wolves or the moon warriors on the way home!
[*]Updated UI
[*]Adjusted difficulty curve
[*]Now unlimited days is the default and only game mode. This is our main direction of designing and balancing the game
[*]Better performance
[*]Also we fixed some of the bugs
[/list]

We planned to release a sandbox update along with Tech Tree but decided to move it’s release a bit and to spend that time on fixing navigation issues. We will make navigation work better and faster for our next update called city building. 

Let us know what do you think about this update in the comments and if you will have any bugs feel free to share them here on Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1330460/discussions/1/ or on our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NcGrRwF

notes.title: Beta is live on main branch!
notes.content: New worker assignment system is live on main branch. It is now way more easier to assign workers and workers losing their job should be a thing of a past now

notes.title: New workers assignment system is live on Beta branch!
notes.content:
Today's update is part 2 of our solution to fix workers loosing their job issue. 

Now when you adding a worker to a building you are creating a request for a worker, and in case if worker dies that work place will be looking for a new worker. So no more reassigning workers to same places when you mismanaged your food stocks or a worker get eaten by wolves.

This way you can also create requests for a worker while you don't have enough workers at this moment, and new workers will automatically run to work places when they spawn.

You can switch to beta branch by clicking on Becastled in your Steam library, then select -> Properties -> Betas -> select "beta" from dropdown.

Cheers!

Hey everyone!

notes.title: New Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that a new Becastled demo is now available! 

Hurry up to try it, as it will last for a week (November 18-24). We hope you enjoy the updated version! Do not forget that you can join our discord: https://discord.com/invite/SEZDCTm to share your impressions, wishes and report bugs. Have a good game!


What is changed in the new Becastled demo?
[list]
[*]Ability to save the game! But be careful, as additional testing is required for this feature.
[*]Fixed many crashes reported by our players. We worked hard on fixing unit stuck in buildings, movement errors, inactivity, sudden profession changes, endless resurrections, unexpected mood changes and much more ...
[*]Now the field is placed on a territory with flowers and tall grass and not just at a certain point.
[*]Lumberjacks cut down all trees in any occupied spaces. Wood is only added when they return to the building, meaning the distance affects the process. And be careful - trees grow slower now.
[*]Unit formations! You can choose exactly how they will stand if you hold down the right mouse button while telling them where to go.
[*]Market is a new building. It has one upgrade. You can choose which resource will be sold. This building brings gold and joy. Each production opens its own unique resource that can be used in trading here. Closeness to other markets gives gold and mood bonuses.
[*]Neutrals - Wolves. They have a boss and a den, where they gradually spawn. To capture a cage with these animals, you must first destroy them along with the spawn. You can only engage in battle with them during the day.
[*]Workers management menu
[*]Ability to assign workers from a building.
[*]Highlighting areas when constructing buildings for collecting resources.
[*]The whole logic of movement of units has been changed. Now it will be easier for us to track and solve problems associated with this.
[/list]

Get demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330460/Becastled/
